spg_prigorodnoe.title: СПГ. Пригородное
spg_prigorodnoe.subtitle: «Зажигая свет новых возможностей»
spg_prigorodnoe.prompt:
Photorealistic photo editing: place the person from image 1 into the base scene from image 3. Preserve their recognisable facial features, gender, hairstyle, skin tone and overall appearance. Match their natural body build from image 2.
Image 3 is the BASE photograph: the Prigorodnoye LNG plant on Sakhalin — a tall flare stack with a burning flame and dark smoke, industrial buildings, green hills and mountains under a heavy overcast sky, wide asphalt area in the foreground. Keep this background, camera angle, framing, perspective and composition unchanged. Place the person standing on the asphalt CLOSE to the camera in the right half of the frame, shown from just below the hips up, large in the frame like a professional fashion editorial portrait — they occupy most of the frame height, with natural depth and slight background separation; correct natural human proportions, the head never enlarged; the flare stack stays clearly visible on the left behind them.
The person is FULLY CLOTHED in a clean white hoodie with a small blue skier emblem and below it the blue Cyrillic inscription "ГОРЫ ЗОВУТ" and "САХАЛИН ОТВЕЧАЕТ" printed in two neat centered lines of capital letters on the chest, and a white baseball cap. IMAGE 4 IS THE OFFICIAL BRAND LOGO (a shield emblem with a lighthouse above the word "САХАЛИН", and NOTHING else — no additional tagline underneath) — reproduce it on the front of the cap EXACTLY as it appears in image 4: the same navy-blue shield emblem with the white lighthouse silhouette and the same "САХАЛИН" wordmark beneath it, identical shapes, proportions and colours, just scaled down and following the curve of the fabric. Do not redraw, restyle or invent a different emblem, and do not use image 4 anywhere else in the picture. The Cyrillic prints must be spelled EXACTLY as given, clean and legible, without extra or distorted letters. Relaxed confident pose, hands in the hoodie pocket, calm friendly expression. EYES: both eyes symmetric, fully open, correct natural shape with defined eyelids, iris and pupil; never squinting, uneven or melted. MOUTH: lips closed in a light natural expression, well-formed, symmetric, sharply defined; never smeared, chewed, doubled or warped.
CINEMATIC COLOUR GRADE like a professional photo shoot at dusk: soft diffused twilight light, gentle filmic contrast with slightly lifted blacks, muted teal-grey sky and warm natural skin tones, subtle vignette, editorial magazine look; no harsh shadows, keep the face softly and evenly lit.
The ENTIRE image must read as a REAL DOCUMENTARY PHOTOGRAPH, never a 3D render or illustration: authentic industrial metal and concrete texture, real grass and rock, natural photographic grain and micro-contrast. Ultra-realistic professional DSLR quality, sharp focus, natural skin texture, correct anatomy and seamless blending. Remove tattoos and blemishes. No nudity, no extra people; no text, watermarks or logos anywhere EXCEPT the specified prints on the hoodie and cap, no background changes, no blur, distortion, plastic skin, AI artifacts or cut-out appearance.
